name: Murphy Malaysia portfolio transactions (2014 partial divestment; 2019 exit) - not WHP costs
description: Two dated, read figures for transactions that transferred the SK309/SK311 assets including West Patricia/Golok/Serampang: Murphy's 2014 sale of 30% of its Malaysian assets to Pertamina at an aggregate purchase price of $2.0 billion (SEC exhibit), and its 2019 all-cash sale of Murphy Sabah and Murphy Sarawak to PTTEP for US$2.127 billion / RM8.62 billion plus an up-to-US$100m contingent bonus. These are asset/equity transaction values, NOT platform capex; kept here only to bound asset value, with explicit basis.

milestones.event: First phase of 30% Malaysian asset sale to Pertamina closed
Murphy exits Malaysia - sale to PTTEP announced

capex.metric: Malaysian assets 30% stake aggregate purchase price (not WHP capex)
capex.basis: '$2.0 billion' aggregate purchase price, effective date 1 January 2014, SEC press release 18 December 2014; USD in billions. Not a platform cost.

capex.metric: Malaysian subsidiary sale consideration (USD, not WHP capex)
capex.basis: 'US$2.127 billion' all-cash, March 2019 article; publication year used, no explicit base year stated. Not a platform cost.

capex.metric: Malaysian subsidiary sale consideration (RM, not WHP capex)
capex.basis: 'RM8.62 billion' as printed beside US$2.127 billion; March 2019; no conversion applied.
'up to US$100 million' contingent on exploratory drilling results before October 2020; stated in March 2019 article; publication year used, no explicit price-level base year stated.
